legal_source.note: Income tax 20% (Tax Code Art. 81(1)) and the income-tax exemption of funded-pension contributions (Art. 82(1)(b3)) are from the rad_law Tax Code snapshot. The 2% employee and 2% employer contributions are Law of Georgia on Funded Pension Art. 3(6)(a)-(b), read on matsne.gov.ge/en/document/view/4280127 on 2026-09-24; that law is not yet in the rad_law corpus. effective_from 2019-01-01 is when the funded pension scheme started, not a verified date for this exact rule. Not covered: the state contribution (paid by the state, not the employer), special rates and exemptions elsewhere in Art. 81-82, non-resident employees. Needs review by a qualified accountant before last_verified_date is set.
